name: PEPSICO INC.  DL-,0166
summary: PepsiCo Inc. is a global food and beverage company that manufactures, markets, and sells a wide range of products, including beverages, snacks, and foods. Its portfolio includes brands like Pepsi-Cola, Frito-Lay, Gatorade, and Quaker. The company is headquartered in Purchase, New York.
